changeSet.author: krusche
changeSet.comment: The scheduled participant score update looks for outdated scores about once a minute with last_result_id IS NULL OR (last_rated_result_id IS NULL AND last_rated_score IS NOT NULL) and finds none, but scanned every score without a rated result (practice runs) to do so. last_result_id is already indexed. This partial index covers the second condition, where the rated score stays behind after its rated result was deleted. It holds no rows while all scores are consistent. A composite index on the two columns is not used by the planner, which keeps preferring the single column index on last_rated_result_id. PostgreSQL only: MySQL has no partial indexes and keeps its current plan.
changeSet.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_participant_score_last_rated_score_orphaned ON participant_score (id) WHERE last_rated_result_id IS NULL AND last_rated_score IS NOT NULL
